before: At the trailing edge of an inline text control, the caret's owning control came from a hit test a quarter point left of the caret. An automatic inter-script gap put that point outside the control, so typing landed beside it. Plain-text paste and the forms-protection admission never named the owning control.
after: The trailing edge of a non-empty inline control resolves from the control's model range. Plain-text paste and admission name the same owning control that typing names, through the existing insertText inside field.
reason: Peers already apply insertText with inside, because typing emits it. The change only decides locally which control a caret insert names. Stored fields, operation encoding, identities, and repair rules do not change.
